name: zapbot
description: Bot para WhatsApp escrito em ClojureScript (piadas, notícias, cotações, previsão do tempo, horóscopo, moderação de grupo).

scripts.build: npm run verify:media-patch && shadow-cljs release app
scripts.test: npm run verify:media-patch && npm run test:ai && npm run test:resources && shadow-cljs compile test && node target/test.js
scripts.test:m4-jvm: node --test test/pokemon-jvm-client.test.cjs test/pokemon-jvm-present.test.cjs test/pokemon-jvm-commands.test.cjs && node scripts/test-pokemon-jvm-contract.cjs && node scripts/test-pokemon-jvm-tx-contract.cjs
